plainLanguage: Section 25 inaanza Chapter VI kuhusu punishments na inaorodhesha aina za punishments ambazo court inaweza impose: death, imprisonment, corporal punishment, fine, forfeiture, compensation, security to keep peace/be of good behaviour or come up for judgment, pamoja na punishment nyingine inayotolewa na Code au sheria nyingine.
meaning: Hiki ni classification/enabling provision, si sentence ya automatic kwa kila offence. Punishment inayoweza kutolewa katika case fulani lazima itokane na penalty provision ya offence, sentencing law na procedural/legal restrictions zinazotumika. Orodha pia inaonyesha kuwa punishment si imprisonment au fine pekee.
keyPoints: Death ni category iliyoorodheshwa katika paragraph (a).
Corporal punishment ni paragraph (c), subject to applicable law governing when/how it may lawfully be imposed.
Fine, forfeiture na compensation ni separate categories.
Security to keep peace/be of good behaviour or come up for judgment ni paragraph (g).
Paragraph (h) preserves any other punishment provided by this Code or another law.
Section 25 itself does not specify which punishment applies to a particular offence.

legalTerms.meaning: Punishment ya kifungo, duration na conditions zake zikitawaliwa na applicable offence/sentencing provisions.
Adhabu ya fedha inayoweza kutolewa ambapo sheria inaruhusu.
Kupoteza property/right kwa order inayoruhusiwa na sheria.
Payment inayoweza kuamriwa kwa madhumuni ya compensation kwa mujibu wa applicable law.
Requirement ya kutoa security kwa peace/good behaviour au kuja kwa judgment kama sheria inavyoruhusu.

examples.title: Offence yenye fine au imprisonment
examples.scenario: Penalty section ya offence fulani inaruhusu fine, imprisonment, au combination kwa masharti fulani.
examples.analysis: Section 25 inaonyesha categories, lakini court lazima irudi kwenye penalty provision husika na sentencing rules kuamua lawful sentence.

examples.title: Compensation
examples.scenario: Case inakidhi statutory conditions za court kuorder compensation.
examples.analysis: Compensation ni punishment category iliyotajwa section 25(f), lakini authority na amount lazima zitokane na applicable legal provisions.

history.summary: Section 25 opens Chapter VI, which then deals with individual punishments in greater detail. Its list must therefore be read with sections 26 onward and any later legislation affecting sentencing.
notes: The presence of a punishment in section 25 does not by itself establish that it is available for every offence.

Because punishment law can be amended and can engage constitutional/procedural requirements, current sentencing work should verify the operative offence and sentencing provisions, not rely only on this list.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Section 25 is best read as a catalogue of punishment types; the actual sentencing power must still be located in the offence and other applicable provisions.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: A lawful sentence requires statutory authority for both the type and applicable limits of punishment; courts cannot infer a free-standing sentencing power from the list alone.

debateQuestion: Kwa offence husika, ni provision gani hasa inayoruhusu punishment, inaweka kiwango gani, na section 25 inaingiaje kama classification ya punishment hiyo?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
